draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 148th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 20th of 37 at CB. He went 136th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: De'Vante Bausby. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (92nd percentile). College production: 4 passes defended in 2020, 20th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 64 career games and 37 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 2.0% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, below the norm.
